headline: 本周影剧速览：保镖恋人领跑，菜鸟老警热播
summary: 本周电影《保镖恋人》热度领先，剧集《菜鸟老警》持续热播，《龙族》也在热剧榜；待映《生化危机：爆发夜》与待播《魔女嘉莉》同样值得关注。

industryHighlights.text: 电影榜：《保镖恋人》《魔法情缘》《偷偷喜欢你》领跑本周热作。
industryHighlights.en: Film chart: Bodyguard Lover, Magic Romance and Secretly Like You lead this week's hits.

industryHighlights.text: 热剧榜：《菜鸟老警》《瑞克和莫蒂》《龙族》等持续热播。
industryHighlights.en: TV chart: The Rookie, Rick and Morty and House of the Dragon continue to draw viewers.

industryHighlights.text: 待播剧：《魔女嘉莉》《完美的谎言》《挑情丑闻》等未播先热。
industryHighlights.en: Upcoming TV: Carrie, Perfect Lie and Tempting Scandal generate early buzz.

industryHighlights.text: 待映电影：《生化危机：爆发夜》《猫鼬》《爱情假说》受期待。
industryHighlights.en: Upcoming films: Resident Evil: Outbreak Night, Mongoose and The Love Hypothesis are anticipated.

headlineEn: Weekly Screen Digest: Bodyguard Lover Leads, The Rookie Heats Up
summaryEn: This week, film Bodyguard Lover leads in popularity, while series The Rookie stays hot and House of the Dragon remains on the buzz chart. Upcoming Resident Evil: Outbreak Night and Carrie are also worth watching.
